name: turnstile
description: Inspect turnstile, the macOS gate that queues builds and tests for memory and per-class slots. Gated commands run through its shims unchanged, so these commands only explain queues, waits, and past runs. Partial community schema covering read-only inspection.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show running and queued jobs, memory level, per-class limits, and recent runs. Reports that the daemon isn't running rather than starting it.

output_fields.name: recent
output_fields.description: Finished runs with key, project, outcome, exit code, duration, peak memory in bytes, and log path.

output_fields.name: limits
output_fields.description: Slots per class: compile, test, and browser.

commands.name: history
commands.description: Summarize what each gated command has cost: estimated and worst peak memory, usual duration, outcomes, and how long jobs waited.

args.name: --here
args.description: Only the project containing the working directory.

output_fields.name: commands
output_fields.description: Per command and project: key, runs, estimate, worstPeak, and usualDuration.

commands.name: logs
commands.description: Print the captured output of a run that had no terminal, such as an agent's. Logs are kept for a day, or a week for failed runs.

args.name: -f
args.description: Follow the output until the run ends.

commands.name: classify
commands.description: Show how a command would be gated: its class and cost key, or pass through.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: One line, such as compile (npm run build) or pass through.
